subject: Q2 QBR + OKR check: BrightWorks health & renewal triage
messages:
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 QBR + OKR check: BrightWorks health & renewal triage

Team — kicking off a short thread to align on BrightWorks ahead of QBR and our OKR checkpoints. Key signals that pushed this into triage: 

- Renewal target: 2027-05-20 (~7 weeks out).
- Product signals: token consumption down 18% MoM; two p95 latency spikes last week (customer reported app-level failures).
- Commercial signals: procurement asks for additional security artifacts (SOC2 evidence) and the customer has redlined parts of SOW re: data retention.
- Behavior: lower usage + support tickets = increased churn risk.

Attachments I’m dropping: health_snapshot.pdf (usage & cost), risk_log.xlsx (initial triage), contract_redlines.pdf (customer comments).

Immediate asks: 
1) Please review the three attachments and add one-line owners in this thread by EOD today.
2) Engineering / SRE: can we confirm a short mitigation plan for the p95 spikes (temporary scale + root-cause ETA)?
3) Legal: need quick read on the redlines — can we accept any language changes without exec signoff?
4) CS: update on customer sentiment and last touch points (BrightWorks exec names).
5) Sales: do not offer commercial credits until we have a clear remediation plan — but list options and rough $ impact so leadership can decide.

Exec attention items (please highlight in replies): 
- Approval to offer a one-off credit (proposed range: $8k–$15k) to bridge procurement while we fix the issue.
- Fast-track legal review on two redline sections related to retention and audit logs.
- Commitment of 1-2 engineer-weeks for a targeted remediation sprint.

Goal: short one-pager for the exec QBR call (4/6) and a readiness checklist for the renewal owner. I’ll draft the one-pager once owners are assigned.

Thanks — Karhtik
Karhtik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karhtik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: health_snapshot.pdf, risk_log.xlsx, contract_redlines.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 QBR + OKR check: BrightWorks health & renewal triage

Thanks Karhtik — good catch. A few quick directives: 

- Prioritize technical mitigation and a communications plan to BrightWorks (CS lead).
- Do NOT finalize any commercial concession without Legal and Finance sign-off; loop in Legal once you have the redline call notes.
- If procurement delays beyond 2 business days after we deliver the requested artifacts, escalate to VP Sales (I’ll take that escalation).

Assign owners here and I’ll review the one-pager before the exec call.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 QBR + OKR check: BrightWorks health & renewal triage

Quick data point from infra: the p95 spikes correlate with a fallback on the older quantized model between 04/24–04/26 (we saw queuing at the shard level). I’ve attached a small trace (latency_trace.png).

Proposed short mitigation: temporary shard autoscale + patch to the KV cache expiry (low risk) — should reduce p95 within 48–72 hours. Engineering estimate: 2 engineer-days to implement and validate; 6 engineer-days to complete a sturdier fix.

For the exec one-pager, recommend 3 bullets: 
- Current impact (usage + tickets).
- Short-term mitigation (time & team).
- Ask (credit approval? engineering commitment?).

I can draft the infra bullets if team wants.

— Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer

Attachment: latency_trace.png

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 QBR + OKR check: BrightWorks health & renewal triage

Adding CS context and an updated renewal risk register. Summary: 

- Customer sentiment: C-level still interested, but product teams reported several timed-out calls over last 10 days. They’ve paused feature rollout pending stability.
- Procurement: asking for SOC2 artifacts + a signed data-retention appendix (see contract_redlines.pdf).
- Commercial ask: they’re requesting a 60-day extended payment term as a condition for renewal.

I recommend these items for exec review: 
1) One-off credit to offset immediate procurement friction — suggested $12,000 (gives procurement runway).
2) Legal quick review of redlines; accept minimal language changes that do not expand retention windows.
3) Assign 2 eng-weeks focused on KV/latency remediation.

Forwarded snippet from BrightWorks (customer email):
> From: Olivia Patterson <olivia@brightworks.io>
> Date: Thu, Apr 1, 2027 16:10:00 -0700
> Subject: Production instability — urgent
> 
> Karhtik / Mina — we’re seeing recurring timeouts in the inference endpoint; this is blocking our rollout. We need a plan and timeline by EOD tomorrow.

I’ve attached risk_register_v2.xlsx and a bundle of customer emails (customer_emails.pdf).

Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager

Attachments: risk_register_v2.xlsx, customer_emails.pdf

Subject: Re: Q2 QBR + OKR check: BrightWorks health & renewal triage

Thanks all — consolidating decisions and owners below (for the exec one-pager):

Owners & due dates:
- Tech mitigation (short-term autoscale + KV expiry): Rishi — deliverable: testable rollback/patch by 2027-04-04 EOD.
- Customer comms and sentiment update: Mina — draft note to Olivia by 2027-04-03 17:00 PT.
- Legal review of redlines: Marissa — provide sign/no-sign guidance by 2027-04-04 12:00 PT.
- Commercial options & $ impact: Karhtik — propose credit and payment-term options by 2027-04-04 12:00 PT.

Exec attention items (for 4/6 call):
1) Approve one-off credit: recommend $12,000 (CS) — need Finance approval and sign-off on accounting treatment.
2) Legal: approve narrow language changes to data retention appendix to close procurement loop quickly.
3) Engineering leadership: commit to 2 engineer-weeks for a remediation sprint in the next 14 days (this is on top of day-to-day backlog).

Proposed immediate next steps: 
- I’ll assemble the one-pager and circulate for review by 2027-04-05 10:00 PT.
- If Legal cannot clear the redlines by 2027-04-04 noon, Laura will escalate to VP Sales and we schedule an emergency exec sign-off.
- Tentative exec sync: Tue 2027-04-06 09:00 PT (30m) — calendar invite to follow once one-pager is ready.

Thanks — I’ll track thread updates and mark the doc in Drive.

— Karhtik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
